title: Reading an approval workflow's table

blocks.text: A school district (invented for this practice) approves its yearly building-repair program with the workflow in `TABLE` (in `approval.py`): a draft is edited and submitted, the board approves or rejects a submission (a rejected program goes back to Draft), and an approved program can only be archived. An auditor wants three answers from the table itself, never from a second copy of the rules:

items: `allowed(state)`: the sorted list of actions the state accepts.
`walk(state, actions)`: apply the actions in order and return `(final state, None)`; if an action is refused, stop there and return `(the state it was refused in, that action)`.

`reachable(state)`: the sorted list of every state that some sequence of allowed actions can lead to from `state`, `state` itself included. The board's question is whether an approved program can ever get back to Draft.

blocks.text:
from __future__ import annotations

#: The board's workflow: (state, action) -> next state. A pair that is not here is refused.
TABLE = {
    ("Draft", "edit"): "Draft",
    ("Draft", "submit"): "Submitted",
    ("Submitted", "reject"): "Draft",
    ("Submitted", "approve"): "Approved",
    ("Approved", "archive"): "Archived",
}


def allowed(state: str) -> list[str]:
    """Every action `state` accepts, sorted."""
    # TODO
    return []


def walk(state: str, actions: list[str]) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """Apply the actions in order; stop at the first refused one. (final state, refused action or None)."""
    # TODO
    return state, None


def reachable(state: str) -> list[str]:
    """Every state some sequence of allowed actions can lead to from `state`, itself included, sorted."""
    # TODO
    return []


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(walk("Draft", ["edit", "submit", "approve"]), reachable("Approved"))

cases.says: a draft that is edited, submitted and approved ends Approved with nothing refused
a sequence stops at the first refused action and reports it
a submitted program accepts approve and reject, and an archived one accepts nothing
from Approved, only Approved and Archived can ever be reached
from Draft, every state can be reached, some only in several steps
